description: Java class 'MongoMetricsReporter' that extends 'AbstractHealthCheckingActor' to report metrics related to MongoDB timers, using Akka actors and pub/sub mechanisms.

classes.name: MongoMetricsReporter
classes.description: Actor class that reports on MongoDB metrics timers, subscribes to pub/sub topics, and manages health status.

classes.name: Tick
classes.description: Inner static class used as a message type for periodic timer ticks.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props for MongoMetricsReporter with specified resolution, history, and pubSubMediator.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Defines message handling for TICK and subscription acknowledgment.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Triggers health status update by rendering current status info.

methods.name: renderStatusInfo
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo object indicating UP status with detailed message.

methods.name: renderStatusDetailMessage
methods.description: Creates a detailed status message with current metrics in JSON format.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves current MongoMetrics object with current path, resolution, and timer data.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Handles periodic tick, updates maxTimerNanos deque with latest timer value.

methods.name: subscribeForTopicWithoutGroup
methods.description: Subscribes to pub/sub topic via mediator.
